title: Internal Admin Tool
description: I’ve worked at Hidden Singapore, a company that creates self-guided games to show people around the local areas of Singapore. I primarily worked on developing their internal app, which they used to manage the company's data, including payment and game creation information. The primary area I worked on was developing an event creation page for other teams within the company to use for creating events for other companies, promoting team building. I designed the page layout, implemented the front-end, and wrote documentation for the endpoints required from the database. I also helped with bug fixing and implementing small features throughout other areas of the admin app.
learnings: Working with a React application in a professional setting
working with developing software without a technical background
